text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.6% today, extending a three-day rally that has recovered most of last week's losses. The timing aligns with a shift in geopolitical sentiment: crude oil prices have stabilized around $90 per barrel after dipping below that level on hopes that Iran tensions may ease. President Trump's recent comments suggesting the Iran conflict could end "fairly soon" appear to have reduced some of the uncertainty premium that was weighing on energy stocks, allowing the sector to catch its breath after the prior week's selloff.

The stock's recovery also reflects broader energy-sector dynamics. While the midterm election results signaled setbacks for fossil fuel companies (particularly regarding renewable energy policy), oil prices themselves have proven resilient in the $90 range despite softening Iran-conflict fears—suggesting that demand fundamentals and global supply concerns remain supportive for crude producers at current levels.
